{{Top|leg}}
'''Yoba''' was a type of food that could be served alongside a [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]].<ref name="invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> 

In [[41 ABY]], [[Hapan Security]] agent [[Taryn Zel]] served [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] a meal of nerf steak with yobas and a glass of [[goff-milk]] during his extraction from [[Nova Station]].<ref name="invincible" />
